summary: Federal Communications Commission urges preservation of E-Rate program to support school connectivity and infrastructure needs The technology director urges the Commission to protect E-Rate and ensure schools can continue providing students with reliable, affordable, and effective connectivity.

claims.argument: Removing E-Rate funding will put a strain on already limited budgets and force cuts to teaching positions
claims.evidence_quote: Pearl River County School District has received $673,215 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $134,643 a year toward the connections our students depend on. That support does not represent a one-time build; it is the recurring cost of keeping a modern network running.
